amendments.cost: nominal fits rise from 184 to 240, still inside the declared hard cap of 250
amendments.does_not_change: the hold-out file set, the hold-out offsets, the estimators, the endpoint, the selection rule, the inference or any success criterion
amendments.made: before any T22 code was written and before any T22 stretch was opened
amendments.what: the development set is extended from the three T10 development files (0000, 0005, 0010) to six stretches, adding the three T10 validation files (0008, 0009, 0011) at start 0; the full band grid runs on the first four eligible-coupled stretches in the declared priority order, and all six carry the B = 1 identity control
amendments.why: at w = 65536 only one of the three original development files (0010) was eligible-coupled in the T10 characterisation (0000 uncoupled, 0005 chirped), so the declared band-selection rule would have had a single input. The three T10 validation files are eligible-coupled, were fully exposed in T10, and are NOT among the T22 hold-out files 0012-0019, so adding them strengthens selection without spending any hold-out.

amendments.does_not_change: the plateau rule, the aggregation or the withholding rule
amendments.made: before any T22 code was written
amendments.what: the evaluation block-length grid gains the candidate 32
amendments.why: the allocation was raised to 300 evaluation windows precisely so that b = 32 leaves nine complete blocks; the T10 grid stopped at 16

amendments.does_not_change: the per-file joint bootstrap or the equal-file primary estimand of the 11 September amendment
amendments.made: before any T22 code was written
amendments.what: the dependence withholding rule is applied to all three benefit verdicts, not only to limited recovery; and the primary combined interval is a two-stage bootstrap that carries within-file uncertainty
amendments.why: audit item (b) and prompt item 5; T10 withheld only the 'useful' verdict, and its combined interval used per-file point estimates with inverse-variance weights

amendments.cost: the development stage is re-scored once with identical seeds and inputs; the contrasts are deterministic and are verified identical to the first run, so no new statistical evaluation is performed. Both runs are archived (v1 and v2).
amendments.does_not_change: the hold-out set, the offsets, the estimators, the endpoint, the selection statistic, the one-bootstrap-sd rule, the inference, the multiplicity control or any success criterion. It changes only which candidate bands are admissible.
amendments.exposure: the first development run (T22_development_v1) computed and displayed the development contrasts for all 22 cells. Development material is what it is for; no hold-out stretch was scored.
amendments.made: on development material, after the first development run and BEFORE any hold-out outcome was read; the hold-out characterisation reads only transfer-calibration windows and reports no method outcome
amendments.what: the second-line admissibility test is restated: a second line is a band bin beyond the one-bin guard that carries at least 10 % of the line bin power AND is a local maximum against its inward neighbour. The previous form compared the observed band power against the idealised boxcar Dirichlet skirt of a single tone.
amendments.why: the previous form rejected every band of width >= 3 on three of the four eligible development stretches. Inspection of the measured band profiles showed why: every profile decays monotonically outward on both sides -- the signature of leakage, not of a second line -- but real TIDMAD skirts sit about four times above the idealised boxcar prediction (rectangular-window leakage plus sub-bin frequency jitter across the 64 calibration windows). The test as written measured 'is the skirt wider than ideal', not 'is there a second line'. Recorded profiles: at B = 17 the relative band powers decay monotonically from the line on both sides on all four stretches, with no local maximum beyond the guard anywhere.

admissibility: every bin of the band is interior at every selection stretch (never DC bin 0, never Nyquist bin m-1)

no second characterised line inside the band (amendment A4): a band bin b with |b - k_inj| > 1 whose mean calibration-reference bin power is at least multi_tone_power_fraction (0.1) of the line bin power AND which is a local maximum against its neighbour one bin closer to k_inj. The guard of one bin is the T10-T12 characterisation's own guard: the immediately adjacent bins always carry the main line's skirt and cannot be resolved from it at boxcar resolution. The local-maximum condition is what distinguishes a line from leakage.
band_selection.aggregation: equal-stretch mean m(B) over the eligible development stretches entering selection
band_selection.eligibility_of_selection_stretches: only development stretches whose characterisation outcome at the T22 stretch is eligible-coupled enter selection; the others are scored, reported and used for the B = 1 identity control, and are excluded from m(B)
band_selection.no_admissible_band: the frozen configuration records selected_band = null with disposition 'blocked-no-admissible-band'; validation and the final test do not run; all three verdicts are reported as not evaluable

resampling.description: one replicate draws, per development stretch, one circular-block resample of its calibration windows (block b_cal) and one of its evaluation windows (block b_eval), refits g_hat and the calibration-dependent estimators, and recomputes Delta_d(B) for EVERY candidate B from the SAME resampled indices; m*(B) is the equal-stretch mean within the replicate, so candidates are paired
resampling.sd: bootstrap standard deviation of m*(B) over the replicates

band_selection.rule: let B* be the admissible candidate maximising m(B) (ties -> smaller B) and s = sd(B*); the selected band is the SMALLEST admissible candidate B with m(B) >= m(B*) - s
band_selection.statistic: per development stretch d and candidate B, the observed mean paired squared-error contrast Delta_d(B) = mean_i [ e2_i(bin read) - e2_i(band-EMPCA) ] over that stretch's 300 evaluation windows
band_selection.ties: the smallest-B search resolves ties by construction; a tie for B* itself resolves to the smaller B

budget.enforcement: the runner enumerates the fits of a stage before opening any data file and refuses to start if the running total would exceed the hard cap
budget.fit_definition: one estimator instantiated on one (stretch, band) cell; the eight declared estimators are counted per cell, as in the T10-T12 accounting

resampling_workload_reported_separately.note: resampling operations are not fits and are never counted against the cap

smoke_runs.counted: separately, marked non-scientific, logged in the exposure record

development.full_band_grid_on: the first four stretches in the declared order whose T22 characterisation is eligible-coupled

holdout.failed_characterisation: outcome recorded, file excluded from every combined estimate, per-file verdict 'excluded-<outcome>'
holdout.fewer_than_three_eligible_validation_fil: the eligible ones become the validation set, status 'underpowered', flagged in every summary; the final test still runs
holdout.final_test_assignment: every holdout file not assigned to validation
holdout.no_eligible_final_test_file: the combined estimate is reported as empty and all three verdicts are 'not evaluable'; per-file rows are still archived
holdout.no_eligible_validation_file: status 'empty'; the final test still runs so the failure regime is reported, and no positive verdict may be issued anywhere
holdout.overlap_with_prior_exposure: none: T10-T12 read [0, 36995072) of each of these files; the T22 stretch begins 32768 samples later
holdout.separation: validation and final test are disjoint by construction; validation outcomes never enter final-test summaries
holdout.validation_assignment: the first three holdout files in index order whose T22 characterisation is eligible-coupled

data_roles.kind: temporal hold-out of files already examined in T10-T12; NOT independent-file replication

dependence.aggregation: each development variance curve normalised by its own V(1); the maximum across (stretch, contrast) taken at each block length; the decision is made on that aggregate
dependence.precision_target: declared before development: an 'inconclusive' aggregate verdict withholds ALL THREE benefit verdicts (limited recovery, denoising benefit, metric contribution), not only the limited-recovery one; a 'stabilised-at-endpoint' verdict permits them but is flagged in every summary
dependence.rationale: 300 evaluation windows at block 32 leave nine complete blocks, the same limiting count as T10's 150/16; the protocol therefore does not claim that the longer evaluation set solves the dependence problem, it only widens the diagnosable range and applies the withholding rule to every claim
dependence.selection: the T10 plateau rule: the smallest plateau candidate whose larger candidates all stay within 1.15 of it; otherwise 'stabilised-at-endpoint' if the two topmost ratios are both within 1.15; otherwise 'inconclusive'

endpoint_definitions.denoising_benefit: Delta(bin read, band-EMPCA) > 0 by the decision rule above
endpoint_definitions.limited_recovery: Delta(zero, band-EMPCA) > 0 and Delta(calibration-mean, band-EMPCA) > 0, both by the decision rule above
endpoint_definitions.metric_contribution: Delta(band-PCA, band-EMPCA) > 0 by the decision rule above, at the same selected B

multiplicity.decision_rule: a claim is declared only if its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND its 95 % interval excludes zero in EMPCA's favour AND the dependence verdict is not inconclusive
multiplicity.p_values: two-sided bootstrap p from the file-level hierarchical bootstrap, p = 2 * min(P(theta* <= 0), P(theta* >= 0)) with the (r+1)/(R+1) continuity correction
multiplicity.per_file_verdicts: descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted; stated as such
multiplicity.reported: unadjusted intervals and raw p-values are reported beside the adjusted decisions

per_file.calibration_only_component: the same bootstrap with the evaluation windows held fixed, reported beside it
per_file.kind: joint circular-block bootstrap (calibration windows and evaluation windows resampled together, g_hat refitted per replicate)

primary_combined_estimand.definition: equal-file mean of the per-file contrasts over the eligible final-test files

interval.description: each replicate resamples the eligible files with replacement and, within each drawn file, draws one value from that file's stored joint-bootstrap replicate array, so within-file calibration and block uncertainty is carried into the file-level interval

primary_combined_estimand.small_sample_rule: with fewer than four eligible final-test files the combined interval is reported as indicative only and the per-file verdicts carry the conclusion

registered_directions.band_empca_vs_band_pca: band-EMPCA better (metric direction, as T10 found at the whole window)
registered_directions.band_empca_vs_bin_read: no direction registered; this is the open question

secondary_sensitivities: inverse-variance (precision-weighted) combination with Cochran's Q and I^2, reported with each file's weight share and never as the headline
equal-file mean with a Student-t interval on the per-file point estimates, i.e. ignoring within-file uncertainty

outputs.draws_npz: per (file, contrast) arrays of the 2000 joint-bootstrap replicate means, plus the band-selection replicate matrix, so every interval and p-value can be recomputed locally without the raw instrument data

json_schema.combined: per contrast: equal-file primary with its hierarchical interval and Holm-adjusted p, plus the three secondary sensitivities
json_schema.per_stretch: characterisation, transfer_calibration, estimator_diagnostics, allocation, band, block_lengths_used, dependence, rmse_by_method_amplitude_units, contrasts, fit_count
json_schema.provenance: code and configuration hashes, input file hashes, seeds, environment, deviations, exposure record, fit accounting

representation.coordinates: real and imaginary parts of the B unitary-rFFT bins centred on k_inj, in the isometric real view (sqrt(2) on interior bins), giving 2B real coordinates
representation.identical_inputs: band-PCA and band-EMPCA receive identical bins, rank, fit windows and preprocessing; they differ only in the metric

identity_assertion.statement: at B = 1 a rank-2 projector on two real coordinates is the identity, so band-PCA = band-EMPCA = bin read exactly

representation.whitening: diagonal Fourier bin powers N_k estimated from 256 science-file noise windows at w = 65536; band-EMPCA uses 1/N_k on both real coordinates of each band bin, band-PCA uses the Euclidean metric
